owner_goal: YouTube ロブロックス リアル as source of impressive craftsmanship; build top-class attractive Roblox-style battle, mobile playable, fun for children, fast iteration
positioning: STYLE-REAL / GAMEPLAY-FIRST: high-art stylized fantasy 3D, not high-end-only photorealistic showcase
audience_hypothesis: kids and younger teens who can enjoy short understandable team action plus returning to collect/train; exact ages and preferences are unvalidated hypotheses

reference_approach.youtube_search_query: ロブロックス リアル
reference_approach.purpose: Discover current visually striking worlds and gameplay, then learn from shape/material/light/animation/optimization; do not assume searched video fully watched
reference_approach.no_ip_copy: Copying someone else's models, maps, characters, textures, audio or UI is prohibited; independently author equivalent design-quality techniques

visual_target.required_playable: Android low/medium visual legibility must persist even with shadows and particles reduced

performance_proposed_thresholds.note: Project acceptance targets, not Roblox official universal benchmarks. Must be verified on real target hardware, never inferred from source or simulator.
performance_proposed_thresholds.baseline_device: one actual mainstream low-end Android, ideally 2–4GB RAM; choose and record named model
performance_proposed_thresholds.comparison_device: one real midrange Android plus a PC
performance_proposed_thresholds.hard_fail_if: critical combat/camera/egg input blocked; crash/OOM; baseline p10<25 or median<30; unreadable enemies/targets at low settings

child_fun_gate.assessment: Small consent-based age-appropriate gameplay session; no personal identifiers in QA, no unsupervised direct interaction with minors

production_speed.small_pr_gates: Source lock, one authority, no colliding route, no permanent HUD, shape/material cost inventory and test evidence plan.
production_speed.milestone_gate: At each official candidate RC batch compare representative BEFORE/AFTER images, run 15-min actual Android session, 3-minute first-user fun test and approve only with human source-linked ratings.
optimization_ladder: first replace ugly silhouettes and placeholder shapes
unify materials and lighting for all devices
use model LOD and instance streaming
reuse meshes/textures and avoid expensive transparent layers/shadows
limit effects to short bursts and nearby players
prefer short unique animations to permanently expensive visuals
production_speed.rollback: Disable only the offending cosmetic feature and preserve authoritative server Game, control inputs and official RC rollback

art_gate_prohibitions: static source compilation called visually beautiful
realistic photo grade expected on every low-end phone
part counts or neon glows as beauty proxy
training on or copying protected third party game assets
extra work delaying critical game-breaking fixes
